behavioral_notes.observation: Short-code generation: create() on link.tracker calls _get_random_code_strings to mint a random ascii_letters+digits code (min length 3, LINK_TRACKER_MIN_CODE_LENGTH); on collision it widens the size and retries, then sudo-creates a link.tracker.code with a unique('code') SQL constraint. The short_url is computed as base_url + '/r/' + code. Not visible in metadata.

The public http route /r/<code> (controller/main.py, website=True) is the click-tracking entrypoint: it resolves the code via link.tracker.get_url_from_code and issues a 301 redirect to redirected_url (or 404 NotFound). Before redirecting it calls link.tracker.click.add_click, CREATING a link.tracker.click row as side-effect. This route lives in controller/main.py so the facts extractor (models-only) reported route_count=0; the route is real.

GeoIP on click: the controller passes request.geoip.country_code and request.httprequest.remote_addr; _prepare_click_values_from_route resolves the country_code to a res.country (country_id) and stores ip. is_a_bot() gates logging so bot/crawler hits do NOT create clicks. count on link.tracker is then recomputed (stored, @api.depends on link_click_ids).

UTM attribution: _compute_redirected_url appends the utm.mixin tracking_fields (campaign/medium/source names) as GET query parameters on the target URL, so the destination receives utm_* params. System param link_tracker.no_external_tracking restricts UTM injection to local (base-url) destinations only. campaign_id/medium_id/source_id use ondelete='set null'.

Mass-mailing integration: convert_links was moved to mail.render.mixin and raises NotImplementedError on link.tracker. tools/html.find_links_with_urls_and_labels walks an lxml tree, makes <a href> absolute and extracts a label, so every link in a mailing body can be wrapped into a tracked short link carrying UTMs. link.tracker.click.campaign_id is a stored related of link_id.campaign_id, and utm.campaign gains a click_count aggregate.

No OWL/JS frontend assets (extract_frontend: present=false). UI is server-rendered backend views only: list/form/graph for link.tracker and a pie/graph 'Click Statistics' for link.tracker.click (default grouped by country). Menu is parented under utm.menu_link_tracker_root and gated to base.group_no_one (debug/technical users).

it_architecture.application: link_tracker (Link Tracker / short-link click-tracking application component)
information_flows: side-effect: GET /r/<code> -> link.tracker.click.add_click creates link.tracker.click (with GeoIP country) -> 301 redirect to redirected_url
side-effect: link.tracker.create -> link.tracker.code (random unique short code)
side-effect: redirected_url carries utm_* GET params (UTM attribution) to the destination

value_streams: Click-to-Insight: shorten URL -> distribute -> visitor hits /r/<code> -> click recorded (GeoIP + UTM) -> campaign click analytics
policies: 9 model-access ACLs (user read-only; public no-access; system full); link.tracker.code unique('code') constraint; bot clicks excluded via is_a_bot(); link_tracker.no_external_tracking restricts external UTM injection
metrics: Click Statistics graph grouped by country / link

classification.apqc_category: 3.0 Market and Sell Products and Services (3.4 Measure and evaluate marketing performance)
classification.rationale: link_tracker is cross-cutting click-tracking infrastructure, not a primary value-creating activity. It has no standalone primary flow: it is consumed by marketing/mass_mailing/utm to measure reach, so it is a support activity (Stabell & Fjeldstad 'support'). Its business contribution is marketing measurement, mapping to APQC 3.0 Market and Sell, specifically 3.4 measuring marketing performance (clicks, UTM attribution, geo). Depends only on utm + mail; exposes a single public redirect route rather than an operational document chain. strategy=null (human).

standard_capabilities: URL shortening with auto-generated unique short codes (/r/<code>)
click capture on redirect (IP + GeoIP country, bot filtering)
click counters on links and per-campaign aggregation
auto-conversion of mailing links into tracked short links (via mail.render.mixin)
typical_fits: tracking clicks on links inside email campaigns / mass_mailing
measuring UTM campaign reach by country
shortening any backend URL and counting visits
common_gaps: no per-click timestamp/visitor-session model beyond ip+country (limited attribution depth)
no out-of-box public dashboard (backend graph views only; menu hidden behind group_no_one)
deduplication / unique-visitor counting not provided (raw click rows)
